title: VSCode Deck Configuration
description: Configuration for the VSCode Deck extension. Defines a Stream Deck-style button grid that runs VSCode commands and shell commands.

$schema.description: URI of this JSON schema. Optional — only needed when the file is stored outside the default `.vscode/deck.json` location and you want IntelliSense to activate.

mode.description:
Where the button grid is displayed.

- `sidebar` — embedded in the activity-bar Deck view.
- `floating` — opens in a separate VSCode window (run `Deck: Open in Floating Window`).

columns.description: Number of buttons per row in the grid.

iconSize.description: Icon size in pixels for every button. If omitted, the extension default (28px) is used.

buttons.description: Buttons rendered in the grid, in display order.

DeckButton.description: A single clickable button in the grid.

title.description: Label shown under the button icon.

id.description:
Optional stable identifier for this button. Use it as the `args` of the `vscodeDeck.runButton` keybinding command — surviving title and category renames. Example keybinding:

`{ "key": "ctrl+alt+b", "command": "vscodeDeck.runButton", "args": "build" }`

icon.description:
Icon for the button. Accepts any of:

- An emoji or short text — e.g. `"▶️"`, `"🚀"`
- An HTTP(S) URL pointing to an image
- A workspace-relative file path — e.g. `"media/run.svg"`
- An inline SVG string — use `currentColor` for theme-aware tinting

color.description: CSS color used for the top-border accent of the button. Any valid CSS color (named, hex, rgb, hsl).

category.description: Optional group header. Buttons sharing the same category are placed under a collapsible heading.

commands.description: Steps run sequentially when the button is clicked. Execution stops on the first failing step unless that step has `continueOnError: true`.

VSCodeCommandStep.description: Invokes a built-in or extension-contributed VSCode command.

command.description: Command identifier. Use `Developer: Inspect Context Keys` or browse the Command Palette to discover IDs.

args.description: Optional arguments forwarded to the command. String values support `${input:name}` and `${input:name:default}` placeholders — these prompt the user when the button is clicked, and the entered value replaces the placeholder.

ShellCommandStep.description: Runs a shell command in a managed pseudo-terminal with full stdin/stdout and Ctrl+C support.

type.description: Run a shell command in a managed terminal.

command.description:
Shell command line. Runs in the user's default shell.

Supports `${input:name}` and `${input:name:default}` placeholders — when the button is clicked, the user is prompted for each unique input. Example: `git checkout ${input:branch:main}` prompts for a branch name (defaulting to `main`).

cwd.description: Working directory for the command. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${workspaceFolder:<name>}` placeholders for multi-root workspaces.

continueOnError.description: If `true`, subsequent steps in the same button still run when this step fails. Use for non-blocking checks like linters or formatters.
